name: Australian couple marrying abroad

sources: Zoho CRM Consumers sample, 712 unique records, 516 genuine couples, analysed 2026-10-28
evidence.supporting_records: about 50 (35 AU-origin destination records plus about 15 picklist destination intents)
evidence.notes: Largest destination segment in the CRM. 0 won, few engaged so far.

demographics.age: 27 to 36 (assumption: age is not captured in the CRM)

context: Found Wedded Wonderland on Instagram. Both work. Planning on a phone at night. Has never been to the venues. Rates their planning progress 1 to 3 out of 10.
jobs_to_be_done: Find a venue abroad that fits our guest count and budget
Know what it will all cost before we commit
Have someone handle it so we are not managing suppliers across time zones
emotional_drivers: Wants it to feel intimate, romantic and authentically us
Wants something different, not a standard package
top_questions: What does this cost all in, and what is included in the from price?
Can it fit our guest count?
Who would actually plan this with us, and what do they do?
How do our guests get there and where do they stay?
Is our budget realistic for this place?

objections.objection: I don't know if my budget is possible for this many people
Planning from overseas, time zones and suppliers I can't meet
Prices look like they start low and will blow out
objections.source: CRM: price or package estimate asked first, about 10 records

objections.objection: Every planner's page looks the same

trust_signals_that_work: A clear from price and what it includes
Who my planner is and the steps
Travel times from a major airport
turn_offs: Long forms before I know anything
verbatims: I have no idea where to start planning my wedding! Any help would be appreciated
I want a luxurious, stress-free planning experience with a focus on high-end, personalized recommendations
Looking for vendors, timezones, budget constraints
decision_role: Couple decides together; family contribution possible but not evidenced
reading_behaviour: Skims on a phone at 10pm after work, saves the page, sends it to their partner, reads properly on the weekend
conversion_threshold: Will enquire once they see a from price with inclusions, a fit for their guest count, and a named person who will plan it
assumptions: Willingness to pay a planning fee
How many can stretch to 100,000+ (only about 8 records at 75,000+ with a destination)
